SELECT job.provider_id, job.model_id, result.generated_text, result.finish_reason, result.input_tokens, result.output_tokens FROM model_call_job job JOIN model_call_text_generation_result result ON result.job_id = job.id WHERE job.id = #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND job.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND job.model_operation = 'TEXT_GENERATION' AND job.execution_status = 'SUCCEEDED'

UPDATE model_call_job SET provider_id = #{providerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, model_id = #{modelId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, execution_status = 'SUCCEEDED', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND model_operation = 'TEXT_GENERATION' AND execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ( (provider_id IS NULL AND model_id IS NULL) OR (provider_id = #{providerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND model_id = #{modelId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) RETURNING

UPDATE model_call_job SET provider_id = COALESCE(provider_id, #{providerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), model_id = COALESCE(model_id, #{modelId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), execution_status = #{terminalExecutionStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_kind = #{failureKind, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, failure_retry_after_seconds = #{retryAfterSeconds, jdbcType=BIGINT}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{jobId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER} AND execution_status = 'RUNNING' AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ( (provider_id IS NULL AND model_id IS NULL) OR (provider_id = #{providerId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND model_id = #{modelId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) RETURNING
